Round-4 review of WP-SCP-022 v0.4.

You reviewed v0.1/0.2/0.3 in R1/R2/R3. Trajectory: R1 had 3 CRIT + 4 MAJ + 1 MIN + 1 nit; v0.2 closed all of those; v0.3 closed all 9 R2 MAJs but introduced no new CRITs (R3 found 1 MAJ + 1 MIN + 1 nit). v0.4 claims to close every R3 finding.

Apply CORRECTNESS lens fresh against v0.4. Verify each R3 correctness finding closed:
- R3-C-MAJ-01 (check_hash_chain wrong path for no-fix-round case): inspect scripts/wp_scp_022_gate_check.sh check_hash_chain — does the no-fix-rounds branch now read review-{lens}.json directly instead of r1-{lens}/dispatcher-result.json?
- R3-C-MIN-01 (R-022-13 missing 020J verify_commands): inspect plan §8 R-022-13 — does it now name explicit verify_commands?
- R3-C-nit-01 (footer 'End of plan v0.2' on a v0.3 doc): inspect plan footer — does it now say v0.4 (or v0.3 was bumped to v0.4)?

Apply lens fresh:
- Plan version 0.4 — consistent across header, footer, and any in-body references?
- Hash-chain layout note in §4.5 — is the discrimination between plan-slice layout and impl-slice layout unambiguous?
- CODEOWNERS reference in §6 — does it correctly forward-reference slice 020K which adds CODEOWNERS?
- §8 R-022-13 — the rollback procedure uses gh REST API endpoint paths. Are they syntactically correct (path templates match GitHub REST docs)?
- Are there any new internal-reference inconsistencies?

Return SonnetReviewResult JSON. Verdict APPROVED if all R3 findings closed and no new MAJs; APPROVED_WITH_FINDINGS if MIN/nit residuals only; CHANGES_REQUESTED if any unmitigated MAJ.
